subject.title: fix(qqbot): use UTF-16-safe truncation for messaging reply and approval previews

question: Should this PR require redacted real QQBot runtime proof before merge, or should a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate for this low-level helper substitution?
rationale: The patch shape is narrow and source-reproducible, but the external contributor has only provided local test/string evidence and ClawSweeper's external-PR gate requires real behavior proof unless a maintainer accepts the gap.

options.title: Require real QQBot proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs, runtime output, or an approval-card/live-run transcript from one changed QQBot path before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the proof gap because the code is a direct replacement with an existing helper and the failure is source-reproducible.

recommendation.title: Require real QQBot proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs, runtime output, or an approval-card/live-run transcript from one changed QQBot path before merge.
